target_resolution_basis: maximum of measured local ground pixel spacing, documented effective resolution, and requested comparison resolution; the coarsest source support is never upsampled; coarsened further to stay within the configured target-cell budget
resampling: area-weighted average; no upsampling below source sampling support

information_loss.planetary: No finer spatial detail is created. Source cells are averaged onto the comparison grid; sub-grid terrain and documented interpolated source cells remain unresolved.
information_loss.earth: Fine-scale terrain is aggregated to the coarsest comparison support and is not retained as resolvable detail in the output.

alignment_description: Each body is centered independently on its supplied coordinate and projected to a local azimuthal-equidistant metric grid at the same cell size; support extents and raster dimensions may differ, and matching array indices have no geographic meaning.
vertical_comparison: relative terrain only; absolute elevations not compared
vertical_normalization: Convert recognized linear units to metres, area-average, then subtract each source's own median over valid output cells; no vertical datum conversion.
area_calculation: Valid area is projected local-grid cell count multiplied by target cell-size squared; it is not an ellipsoidal geodesic area measurement.
common_mask_semantics: Unavailable for unequal support dimensions; candidate-level feature masks are evaluated against the planetary reference during discovery.
warnings: Earth and planetary grids use independent local CRSs and origins; array indices represent paired support only.
Vertical datums and reference surfaces are not reconciled; each output is centered on its own valid-cell median.
At least one product has no documented effective spatial resolution; nominal sampling is only a conservative grid floor.
The requested support would exceed the ScaleBridge cell budget. The comparison grid was transparently coarsened to 25.05 m; the report records this scale and no finer terrain information is implied.
Input vertical references differ and absolute elevations must not be compared.
Planetary reference and Earth search supports have different dimensions; no single paired-cell mask is defined. Candidate-level feature masks are computed independently during discovery.
